defects.description: The Pod volume's persistentVolumeClaim.claimName is `pv-claim`, but the PVC defined in this manifest is named `task-pv-claim`.
paraphrases: claimName points at `pv-claim`, but the PVC is `task-pv-claim`.
The referenced PVC name should be `task-pv-claim`, not `pv-claim`.
Dangling PVC reference: `pv-claim` is never defined.
defects.rationale: Findable by comparing the claimName (line 23) to the PVC metadata.name (line 4); should be task-pv-claim.

defects.description: The container's volumeMount references volume `pv-storage`, but the Pod defines the volume as `task-pv-storage`.
paraphrases: The volumeMount name `pv-storage` does not match the Pod volume `task-pv-storage`.
Dangling volume reference: the mount names a volume the Pod does not define.
defects.rationale: Findable by comparing the volumeMount name (line 32) to the Pod volume name (line 21); should be task-pv-storage.

defects.description: The Pod is in namespace `production`, but the PVC it claims is in namespace `default`; PVCs are namespace-scoped, so a Pod can only bind a PVC in its own namespace.
paraphrases: The Pod (namespace production) cannot bind a PVC in namespace default.
Namespace mismatch: the PVC is in `default` but the Pod is in `production`.
A PersistentVolumeClaim reference only resolves within the same namespace.
defects.rationale: Findable by comparing the Pod namespace (line 18) to the PVC namespace (line 5); should be default.
